info.title: SAMPURNA API
info.description:
360° Human Wellness & Life Balance — *Balance Within. Harmony Around. Well-being for All.*

REST API shared by the web PWA and future native mobile apps. Wellness scores are self-assessment indicators, not medical diagnoses or professional financial assessments.

get.description: Right to access: a machine-readable copy of the person's data.

delete.description:
Right to erasure: soft-delete assessments, revoke grants, anonymise identity.

Rows are retained in de-identified form only where referential integrity of
shared records (e.g. a coach's interview log) requires it.

post.description: Execute one agent independently and synchronously.

Draft a summary from recorded scores and observations.

The draft is returned for the interviewer to review; it is NOT saved and it
never modifies the individual's answers or scores.

get.description: User management. Deliberately excludes any wellness data.

Anonymised, aggregated category averages with a minimum group size.

Uses each person's latest assessment only. Groups smaller than the minimum
size are suppressed so no individual can be singled out.

post.description: Reminder engine entry point — call from a scheduler (e.g. daily cron).
